style.backgroundSystem: one surface family per screen: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, mint wash panel #E8F1E9 for claim and closing screens, mist blue panel #DCE7EF for pain and trust screens, frosted shelf interior #EDEFEA for the in-fridge scene; never a random kitchen scene behind an infographic panel
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in #7FA8C9 inside small rounded frames or circles, low complexity, no filled pictograms, no 3D badges, no real appliance or store marks
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral 5500-6500K studio light with a soft front-left key and bounce fill, one narrow rim highlight along moulded lid and rim edges, honest contact shadow under every base tray; the in-fridge screen alone switches to a cold shelf light from above around 4300K with faint vapour
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cool-tone stackable food-storage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain white #FFFFFF, mint green #A9CDB6, mist blue #7FA8C9 accent and charcoal text #2F3A3B, with one apricot #EFA45B reserved only for cold and hot applicability chips; cool neutral 5500-6500K studio lighting with a soft front-left key, bounce fill, one narrow rim along moulded edges and honest contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family with short Chinese copy kept inside 「」; background system of seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF, mint wash #E8F1E9, mist blue #DCE7EF and frosted shelf #EDEFEA, one surface family per screen; layout system of generous top-left text blocks, thin 1px rule lines, 8px rounded card corners, 2x2 grids and dimension leader lines; icon system of single-weight thin line icons in #7FA8C9 with no fills; product kept as a true-proportion vertical stack with the clasp and carry fitting fully in frame and never floating without a contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented capacity, dimension, temperature or certification claims.
noDrift: no invented capacity, dimension, temperature, food-safety or certification claims
no source store badge, membership block or QR code
style.presentationRules: the stacked trays keep a true vertical stack axis and correct tray-to-lid proportion in every screen; the open mouth faces the camera only in overhead screens; the lid clasp and any carry fitting stay fully inside the frame; lids square to the frame in variant rows; contact shadow always present; food inside a tray reads as generic simple dough parcels laid in tidy parallel rows, never scattered, never flour-dusted
style.surfaceSystem: frosted translucent tray walls with visible fine matte grain, matte mint lid, pale stone shelf #EDEFEA, one pale timber board #C79A6B allowed as a warm scale anchor; no tabletop prop taller or larger than the stack
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered text, headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, copy in #2F3A3B on light panels and #FFFFFF on the mint and mist panels; short Chinese lines only inside 「」 placeholders, no serif, no handwriting, no brush lettering, no cartoon type
